description_zh: 使用当前运行系统的分享功能，分享到另一个应用程序。
description_en: Use the system's share functionality to share something via another app.

conditions.description_zh: 检测当前运行设备是否支持分享功能。
conditions.description_en: Test if the sharing actions are supported on this platform.

conditions.description_zh: 检测当前运行的平台是否支持 '附加文件' 操作分享文件。
conditions.description_en: Test if sharing files via the 'Add file' action is supported on this platform.

conditions.description_zh: 用户完成分享动作后触发。注意，这并不一定意味着用户实际分享了任何内容。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after the user completes a share. Note this does not necessarily mean anything was shared.

conditions.description_zh: 如果共享未成功或发生错误，则触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered if a share is not completed successfully or an error occurs.

actions.description_zh: 调起系统的分享功能，可以带有标题、内容、网页信息，以及来自二进制数据的文件内容。
actions.description_en: Share some text with an optional title and URL, and any files that were previously added.

params.desc_zh: 要分享的信息，留空则忽略。
params.desc_en: The message to share. Leave empty to omit.

params.desc_zh: 分享时显示的标题，留空则忽略。
params.desc_en: The title or subject of the share. Leave empty to omit.

params.desc_zh: 要分享的链接，留空则忽略。
params.desc_en: A URL to share. Leave empty to omit.

actions.description_zh: 在 '分享' 动作前使用，允许将二进制数据附加到分享内容中。注意，这需要设备支持文件共享功能。
actions.description_en: Add the contents of a Binary Data object as a file to attach to the next share. Note only works if 'Is sharing files supported' is true.

params.desc_en: Name of the file to add.

params.desc_zh: 要添加的文件的内容类型，也称为MIME类型。
params.desc_en: Content type (also known as MIME type) of the file to add.

params.desc_zh: 要使用的二进制数据对象。
params.desc_en: A Binary Data object to use as the content of the file.

actions.description_zh: 弹出请求为你应用评分的窗口
actions.description_en: Display a dialog requesting the user to rate your application.
actions.display_zh: 弹出请求评分窗口 (正文: [i]{0}[/i], 确认按钮: [i]{1}[/i], 取消按钮: [i]{2}[/i],  AppID: [i]{3}[/i])
actions.display_en: Request app rating (body: [i]{0}[/i], confirm: [i]{1}[/i], cancel: [i]{2}[/i], app ID: [i]{3}[/i])

params.desc_zh: 请求评价对话框的正文。仅适用于没有安装 Google Play 应用商店的安卓设备。
params.desc_en: The body text of the request review dialog (Android with no Google Play Store App only).
params.initialValue: "If you enjoy using MY_APP_NAME, please take a moment to rate it. Thanks for your support!"

params.desc_zh: 确认按钮的文字。仅适用于没有安装 Google Play 应用商店的安卓设备。
params.desc_en: The text of the "confirm" button on the request review dialog (Android with no Google Play Store App only).

params.desc_zh: 取消按钮的文字。仅适用于没有安装 Google Play 应用商店的安卓设备。
params.desc_en: The text of the "cancel" button on the request review dialog (Android with no Google Play Store App only).

params.desc_zh: 请求评分的应用程序ID。留空则使用在项目属性中填写的应用程序ID。仅适用于没有安装 Google Play 应用商店的安卓设备。
params.desc_en: The app ID to request a rating for (Android with no Google Play Store App only). Leave empty to use the project's app ID.

actions.description_en: Open the 'rate app' store page for an app.
actions.display_en: Display store page for app ID [i]{0}[/i]

params.desc_zh: 要打开商店页面的应用程序ID。留空则使用项目设置中的应用程序ID。
params.desc_en: The app ID of the store page to open. Leave empty to use the project's app ID.
